scientific_integrity: The complete theorem has an elementary direct proof. Supporting examples and exact arithmetic checks do not substitute for proof; existing parallelotope and ball results are credited.
scientific_limitations: The necessary-and-sufficient product law requires orthogonal Euclidean products with normalized Euclidean boundary area.
The explicit cone-based factor family requires central symmetry and constant supporting facet height or Euclidean balls.
A matching result in unindexed historical literature cannot be excluded; independent validation has not been performed.
title: A Cartesian-product characterization of geometric volume–surface convex order
